BiblicalUsage: The sixth day ends the creation of man and woman, the sixth day brings a double portion of manna, the sixth year carries a blessing for three years, and the sixth day brings its offering at the dedication. Six is the day that finishes the work and points to the rest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sixth day is the day God looked at everything He had made and called it very good. I hold that the double portion on the sixth day is the pattern: God provides ahead for the rest He commands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
